items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: I was studying classical bass, and classical bass (inaudible). He writes right now with Eddie Gomez. ... I like Eddie Gomez.

ctx.x: Well, a lot of guys -- see, like, Eddie Gomez, they can (inaudible), but they don't. They only play up high. Some musicians (inaudible), but Jimmy Blanton played up high and down low, (inaudible).
And the guys before him, aside from covering the whole instrument, I guess -- was their rhythm different than Blanton? Did he loosen up the rhythm?
